weakens_tests.reason: line 42's regex widens from the literal 'owner approval' to an explicit allowed set (?:owner|machine|policy) approval, because CLAUDE.md rule 51 was reworded by the bridge period (#5021) from 'owner approval' to 'machine approval'. Sparring round 1 (R1-F1) first widened this to an unrestricted \w+ approval; the lane review (VTID-05785) found that too loose — it would also match a nonsensical 'no approval' (proved in outputs/mutations.txt, 'C3 counter-mutation': the \w+ wording wrongly passes against corrupted text that the allowed-set wording correctly rejects) — so the final diff pins the word to the three wordings rule 51 has actually used: owner (pre-VTID-05214), machine (current), and policy (named in the same sentence for the CI-sparred path). A future wording tweak adds its word here, deliberately, never an arbitrary word.
